Type: epic
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: EP6
Accountable role (person unassigned): Institutional service owner
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: A named institution can make an evidence-backed decision to run a bounded pilot.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The service owner accepts source/data boundaries, capacity, recovery objectives, responsibilities and any conditional integrations.
2. Representative correctness/load evidence, independent access review, actual user/accessibility results and operator-led recovery meet that scope.
3. A recorded pilot go/no-go distinguishes open blockers from accepted limits; primary-repository migration remains a separate decision.

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
